name: Linkedin Leads
description: Trawls LinkedIn posts and their comment threads for prospects matching keywords you supply, with optional include and exclude terms to tighten the results. Output quality rests on how well-chosen your keywords are; broad ones will return a lot of noise.

official.title: Linkedin Leads by Angel
official.description: Busca leads en LinkedIn en publicaciones y comentarios a partir de las palabras clave que le des, con filtros de incluir/excluir opcionales.
